pairs.titel: What did she say about the Church?
pairs.frage: Her answer in the prison session of 17 March 1431, and the twelfth article the judges drew from it.
pairs.note: In her prison Jeanne said that God and the Church were 'all one', that she submitted all her deeds to the Church above, and that on the Church Militant she would answer nothing more for now. The twelfth article turns this into a refusal to submit to 'any man in the world', made, it says, against the article of the creed explained to her many times. The Faculty of Decrees called it schism; the nullity trial asked whether the articles had fairly stated her answers.
